title: Open Book Question Answering Dataset (OBQA)
summary: This community centers on the 2018 paper 'Can a Suit of Armor Conduct Electricity? A New Dataset for Open Book Question Answering' and its four authors. The paper introduces a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate models' ability to answer questions that require combining external knowledge with reading comprehension. It serves as a foundational resource in the field of open-domain question answering.
key_findings: The core entity is a 2018 paper titled 'Can a Suit of Armor Conduct Electricity? A New Dataset for Open Book Question Answering'.
The paper was authored by a team of four researchers: Todor Mihaylov, Peter Clark, Tushar Khot, and Ashish Sabharwal.
The dataset is specifically designed for 'Open Book Question Answering,' a task requiring models to use provided context and external knowledge.
The paper is cited in the context of recent advancements in Graph Representation Learning and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), indicating its continued relevance as a benchmark.
